notes: Exact game/protocol/math identities and purchase literals derived from successful complete native capture sequences.
Normal uses the minimum positive fresh-init bet; purchases use only observed exact bet/price pairs.
Native binary and sessionData are opaque and preserved. Fresh init need not carry sessionData; all nonterminal action responses must.
Continuations and choice index sequences are scoped to the captured game/mode. Unknown actions or exhausted choice sequences remain partial.
The supplied captures were parsed/reserialized upstream; source SHA256 identifies the supplied file, not original HTTP byte serialization.
Rejected rp_120 freespin price375 and rp_171 freespin price250 are intentionally unsupported; old missing purchases rp_65/rp_57/rp_37/rp_26/rp_29 remain unsupported.
